name: Uehara Himari
source:
A normal girl who believes in the legend of the cherry blossom tree.

A second-year student at Garupa Private Academy and the main character of this game.
Always cheerful, bright, and authentic with everyone, she has many friends at school.
Her grades are as average as they come.
A member of the Tennis Club.
After learning of the legend of the cherry blossom tree, her heart is filled with anticipation.

[From Official site]
